description.zh:
数据库账号名称。
不能使用某些预留关键字，如 SYS、root 等。
description.en:
The name of the database account.
Certain reserved keywords such as SYS and root cannot be used.

description.zh:
数据库账号访问密码。
必须包含大写英文字符、小写英文字符、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为 10-32 位； 特殊字符为：!@#$%^&* ()_ +-=
description.en:
The logon password of the database account.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The password must be 10 to 32 characters in length. Supported special characters are: !@#$%^&* ()_ +-=.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro modify-tenant-user-password --user-name pay_test --tenant-id t4pnum0000 --user-password '!Aliyun4Oceanbase' --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --encryption-type RSA --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro ModifyTenantUserPassword --region cn-hangzhou --EncryptionType RSA --TenantId t4pnum0000 --UserName pay_test --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --UserPassword '!Aliyun4Oceanbase'
